coaching.headline: TwinBlast and Serath won the 1-3 fights before the first Fangtooth and the duo outer; TwinBlast scored four of the last five kills.

flags.text: Final fight: Skylar's two kills, then five straight enemy kills as Steel razed the offlane outer.
Enemy took both Fangtooths after deaths: three in a 1-3 duo-lane loss, then Lt. Belica.
TwinBlast took the allied duo outer after Bayle, Skylar and Phase died in another 1-3 loss.
Outside any detected fight, Renna killed Aurora, Lt. Belica and Bayle: three of Renna's seven kills.

focus.title: Find Renna and Serath before the pit
focus.action: Before each Fangtooth or duo-lane fight, confirm where Renna and Serath are; if Renna or Serath is unseen, Bayle, Phase and Skylar back off together rather than trading three deaths for one.

8.5.call: Lost 1-3 on the duo lane in the enemy half: TwinBlast killed Bayle, Serath killed Phase, Skylar killed TwinBlast, Serath killed Skylar, and enemy Fangtooth followed. Ahead of a Fangtooth spawn, the duo trades from the allied half of the lane.

10.6.call: Two separate plays, not one fight. Offlane: Serath killed Aurora. Duo lane: Bayle killed TwinBlast, then Renna killed Phase and Skylar on the allied side. With Renna showing on the duo lane, Phase and Skylar give ground until help is confirmed.

15.4.call: Lost 1-3: Serath killed Bayle first on the duo lane, Phase killed Adele at the Fangtooth pit, TwinBlast killed Skylar on the duo lane, Serath killed Phase in the allied jungle, and the allied duo outer fell to TwinBlast. Once Bayle drops first, concede the tower instead of losing two more.

20.7.call: Skylar killed Adele and Serath, then TwinBlast killed Phase, Bayle, Skylar and Lt. Belica and Renna killed Aurora, mostly at the Fangtooth pit, while Steel took the allied offlane outer. After a two-kill start, back off and reset instead of extending the fight.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Six deaths against a 3.3 norm, three to TwinBlast, including a death outside any detected fight on the duo lane. With TwinBlast unseen, hold farm under tower rather than trading.
Top allied hero damage, 16190, and both closing-fight allied kills, on Adele and Serath. When TwinBlast turns a fight, back off with Phase rather than chase.
ff1e6bc4-1464-4806-a7eb-a11264463c9d: First allied kill, on Steel in the enemy half of the offlane, plus 9.5 CS per minute over a 7.3 norm. When Steel backs off, keep that farm pace.
Took the game's last death at the Fangtooth pit after Steel razed the offlane outer. If Steel shows offlane during a pit fight, call the tower threat first.
bd0641e7-6bbe-45d9-8b16-a1fd669198da: Five deaths against a 2.5 norm, two before minute ten, starting with first blood to TwinBlast on the duo lane. After an early lost trade, reset before re-engaging.
Eight wards against a 13.5 norm while Adele placed 10. With Silentium's three-ward cap, fill the Fangtooth approaches before each spawn.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Died first in two of three 1-3 fights: to TwinBlast before the first Fangtooth, to Serath before the duo outer. Save Kingslayer until Phase and Skylar can follow.
Serath finished 6/1/6 with 22257 objective damage and five wards cleared; seedlings went 0-3. When Serath shows on one side, take the seedling on the opposite side.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zero kills and 444 hero damage per minute against a 734 norm while Renna finished 7/0/4. Next time Renna trades, open with Seismic Assault's stun before Void Bomb.
Both duo-lane deaths went to Renna, the second in an even 1-1 skirmish before an enemy Fangtooth. Before leaving mid, ping Renna's location and go only with Bayle.

matchup: Duo was Skylar and Phase against TwinBlast and Adele; the allied duo died four times before minute ten, the enemy duo once.
TwinBlast killed Skylar three times and Skylar killed TwinBlast twice; Serath added two more Skylar deaths.
build: Vanquisher executes a hero taken below 5% health, a finisher for TwinBlast or Renna fights.
Plasma Blade gains 4% critical chance per basic attack on heroes, stacking five times.
eternal: Weald's major shoots true-damage projectiles at heroes under 30% health; Forage pays extra gold and XP per minion or monster kill.
Wind-Rider grants bonus attack speed after a dash, pairing with Pacifier's Adrenalize dash.
Weald is the only Skylar carry Eternal with enough games to rank: most played, no edge claimed.
augment: Assault MK-II lengthens the Air Assault hover and fires an extra missile with each attack.
Most played Skylar carry augment; Plasma Barrage has too few games to rank, so no edge is shown.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical hit; the bonus damage rises 2.5x on targets below 20% health.
Liberator is the most played Skylar carry crest and the only crest with enough games; Pacifier is listed, not ranked.
improvement: Kit read: Liberator's cleanse would strip Adele's roots and Renna's mesmerize, giving up Pacifier's dash and low-health burst.
No item change is proven by the match.

matchup: Offlane opponent Steel went 0/1/3, the lone death to Aurora's early kill, and later razed the allied offlane outer.
Steel stuns with Shield Bash, Bull Rush and Shield Slam, and finished with 18360 damage mitigated.
build: Flux Matrix makes nearby enemy heroes take 10% more magical damage and halves enemy tenacity.
Magnify cuts magical armor on ability hits against heroes, stacking five times.
eternal: Knell's Rust shreds both armor types on hits and returns part of the shred; Peal applies maximum Rust after the ultimate.
Patina grants a shield after ten seconds without taking damage.
Aurora offlane lacks a field cell on the current patch, so the Eternal read is kit only.
augment: Glacial Thorns spawns crystals at the base of Glacial Charge that damage and root.
No Aurora offlane augment ranking exists yet; kit read only.
crest: Tempest's Overcharge damages up to three nearby heroes each second and heals off the damage dealt.
Crest choice for Aurora offlane carries no field ranking yet.
improvement: Kit read: Fire Blossom over Magnify adds physical armor and a burn aura into the three-physical enemy comp, giving up magical-armor shred.

matchup: Duo opponents were TwinBlast and Adele; TwinBlast took first blood on Phase on the duo lane.
Serath killed Phase twice and Renna once: three of five deaths came from outside the enemy duo.
build: Enra's Blessing shields a nearby immobilized ally, relevant into Adele's roots and Steel's stuns.
Marshal buffs Phase and nearby heroes with 15% attack speed and on-hit damage, feeding Skylar's basic attacks.
eternal: Exarch gives healed or shielded targets 10% attack speed and bonus magical on-hit damage.
Exarch is the most played Phase support Eternal and the sole option with enough games, so no edge is shown.
Preservation with Fervour is the only minor pair with enough games; Revelation with Fervour is too thin to rank.
augment: Kindred Surge adds movement speed and health regen to Hyperflux for the full duration.
Kindred Surge is the lone Phase support augment past the games floor: most played, edge unclaimed.
crest: Silentium's Muzzle active silences a hero briefly; the Visionary passive raises the ward cap from two to three.
Tranquility is the only Phase support crest with enough games; Silentium has no recorded games in the field.
improvement: Kit read: Tranquility's group heal and damage mitigation adds sustain into TwinBlast's burst, giving up Muzzle's silence.
Preservation over Revelation trades basic cooldown cuts for 10% more healing and shielding received.

matchup: Jungle opponent Serath killed Bayle once, in the loss before the duo outer fell; Bayle's lone kill was on TwinBlast.
Heaven's Fury makes Serath CC immune and invulnerable during the dash; save the Cursed Edge third-slash stun until after.
build: Basilisk shreds physical armor on hero damage and erodes at six stacks; Earthshaker ramps ability damage per hit.
No armor in the build; the film flags a three-physical enemy comp.
eternal: Marrow heals off hero damage, more at low health; Leech cuts nearby enemy base health regen.
Roses pays more bonus gold with each previous takedown and boosts the Marrow major after hero kills.
No Bayle jungle field data exists, so the Eternal stands on kit fit.
augment: Betrayer's Reqiuem uppercuts every enemy around the first Kingslayer target and cuts Kingslayer's cooldown by 15%.
Kit read: the area uppercut suits grouped duo-lane fights; the Bayle jungle field holds no augment data.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver deals area damage and heals on hero hits; each later hero hit heals at half strength.
Crest choice for Bayle jungle has no field ranking to lean on.
improvement: Kit read: Forticus in place of Earthshaker adds physical armor and a shield when hit by heroes, giving up the ability-damage ramp.

matchup: Renna killed Lt. Belica twice on the duo lane; TwinBlast scored the third death at the Fangtooth pit.
Renna's Stupor mesmerizes and Mortal Coil pulls and executes low targets; Neural Disruptor's silence briefly blocks Renna's ability casts.
build: Combustion adds area damage on ability hits; Noxia marks a hero, then a second ability adds 6% max-health damage.
eternal: Aion grants mana regen per cast and gold from spell damage on heroes; Bottomless Vial pays off on river buff kills.
Vesh is the most played Lt. Belica mid Eternal; Aion has too few games to rank.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience each second.
Combat Veteran leads Devastating Bombs only as a toss-up in the Lt. Belica mid field: best odds, no clear edge.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima grants a shield plus magical lifesteal and movement speed for 8s.
Epoch is the only Lt. Belica mid crest with enough games; Soulbearer is listed, not ranked.
improvement: Kit read: Epoch gives up Soulbearer's shield, lifesteal and movement speed for a stasis to use during Renna's Abyssal Rift.
No Eternal change is proven: Vesh is most played but shows no edge.

threats: Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
ourKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
ourKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
ourKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
ourKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
ourKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs
